plan.goal: Strictly greater than 75% pure wins against all 15 frozen opponents, learned improvements only, expandable market vocabulary
plan.metric: wins / all games strictly > .75; draws are not wins
plan.seeds: Every match has its own unique seed, disjoint from all known prior registered seeds
plan.initialization: Warm start from trained expanded candidate; this is not a promotion of that candidate
plan.architecture: Independent market quantity MLP copied from the frozen shared quantity MLP

training.selection: Lowest validation loss among trained checkpoints; reject before games if full action accuracy drops more than 0.5 percentage points
training.method: Teacher BC with accumulated training data, fresh balanced rollouts, automatic vocabulary union and independently trainable market quantities
training.trainable: Market pattern head, pattern embedding and market quantity MLP; shared encoder, unit head and unit quantity MLP frozen

constraints.vocabulary_source: Union of initialization and training labels only; expandable each round

cpu.scope: Only owned job and descendants are throttled; unrelated activity can exceed whole-machine ceiling

vocabulary_source: Training labels only, never validation or evaluation
